title: Pit-Firing Events
source_quote: Firing Raku or the Pit occur Spring, Fall and Winter but due to summer heat and burn conditions we rarely will fire during summer months.
evidence_sentence: Pit firing is offered seasonally to current students and external artists who bring their own pots.
evidence_quote: External Artists (Pit-Firing only): Bring your own
summary: Pit firings happen seasonally (spring, fall, winter). Current students pay $20 to audit or $50 to participate. External artists welcome and pay $75 (with own materials) or $95 (using school materials). Contact Tanya to join the notification list for firing schedules.
cost_text: Current Students: $20 to audit, $50 to participate; Advanced Students: included in class; External Artists: $75 (bring own, no school materials), $95 (bring own, using school materials)
how_to_join: Contact Tanya@cedaroakfarm.org or call (704)750-9821 to get on the notification list for firing schedules.
bring: Own bisqued pots; external artists must provide their own pots
